Its real variant list came from the schema's OWN HISTORY (handler.py @42df870: torn_paper, sticky_note, quote_card, lower_third, caption_match), not from the current enum — which had been pruned to two while _TextOverlay kept carrying topText/bottomText, quote/attribution and text, the fields of the three retired ones. A family reads as two variants and is five. The filename keeps its historical number; this key is the count. COUNT 78 -> 79 on 2026-09-19: PlainText added as the SIXTH variant. It is not in the old schema's list, and it is not a new idea either — it is the shape Builder-2 measured as the references' most common text (plain, medium, middle). CaptionMatch served that shape for one day only because its port was incomplete: it rendered a fixed sans-serif and never read the caption style it is named for. Once CaptionMatch honoured the edit's chosen style, the plain shape left the menu with it, so the workhorse gets its own component named for what it is.

COUNT CORRECTED 79 -> 77 on 2026-09-20, and the two are a phantom and an omission in the SAME family.

THREE ENTRIES NAMED COMPONENTS THAT DO NOT EXIST. DeviceMockup, EmojiCard and EvidenceCard were listed under motion graphic with NO body in ported_mg/ and NO entry in chatcut_registry.json -- not even in its "refused" list, which is where a component that was built and rejected goes. They are not refused, they are ABSENT. They appear in Builder-1's 51a2b2f as the families that "were waiting for" the source-layer capability, and somewhere between being unblocked and being built they were written down as though the unblocking had built them. A capability that MAKES a component possible is not the component.

AND ONE THAT DOES EXIST WAS MISSING. SpeechBubble has a body in ported_mg/ and sits in the registry's refused list, and was in no family here at all. So the same family was over-counted by three and under-counted by one, which nets to two -- and that is exactly why a NET figure is the wrong thing to check: had either error been one larger they would have cancelled, the total would have stayed 79, and the file would have read correct while naming three things that do not exist.

THE LIST IS NOW DERIVED FROM ported_mg/ RATHER THAN MAINTAINED BESIDE IT. A hand-kept list of the things that exist drifts from the things that exist; that is the whole defect. 29 bodies, 29 names.

and the first thing to look components up BY NAME — the inventory's picture
field — gave the overlay the TRANSITION's still and reported 14 of 15 pictured
while showing ShutterFlash twice. A wrong picture is worse than a missing one:
the missing one is counted.
